course_name_original: Manteniment i Operació de Sistemes de Fabricació
course_name_en: Maintenance and Operation of Manufacturing Systems
prerequisites: EM1012 - Mecànica de Màquines i Estructures
EM1015 - Ciència i Tecnologia de Materials
EM1019 - Elasticitat i Resistència de Materials
EM1020 - Teoria de Màquines i Mecanismes
EM1028 - Màquines i Instal·lacions de Fluids

learning_outcomes.text: To know how to combine different maintenance, productivity, and quality programs for operational improvement through an integrated team project.
To know how to apply the concepts of reliability, risk analysis, and maintenance viability to manufacturing-production systems.
To know how to explain the main data flows and structures for maintenance management.
To know how to select the most appropriate maintenance/quality policies and programs in each situation.
To know how to plan and schedule maintenance tasks for a manufacturing system.
To know how to calculate maintenance indicators and costs.
To explain the basic concepts related to comprehensive maintenance of equipment and systems.

syllabus_topics: Thematic Block I: Statistical and system reliability fundamentals and basic maintenance concepts
Topic I.1.- System reliability and maintainability
Topic I.2.- System availability and safety
Topic I.3.- Types of maintenance and maintenance costs
Thematic Block II: Analysis and engineering techniques in maintenance
Topic II.1.- Quality in manufacturing and maintenance
Topic II.2.- Failure analysis techniques: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis and other related techniques
Thematic Block III. Maintenance strategies and productivity improvement programs.
Topic III.1.- Maintenance strategies: analysis of different preventive maintenance policies
Topic III.2.- Total Productive Maintenance and other productivity and quality improvement programs
Practical session 1.- Idling verification of a machine-tool
Practical session 2.- Study and improvement of a mechanized process using Failure Mode and Effects Analysis Technique
Practical session 3.- Performing a Time Study of a machining job
teaching_methods: Lectures, using transparencies and performing demonstrations on the board, in theory classes.
Resolution of practical exercises and problems, along with the presentation and discussion of practical cases, in problem classes.

Laboratory work in laboratory classes. These will be carried out in workshops, where students will analyze and execute practical scenarios related to machine-tool maintenance and verification and process productivity improvement. These sessions also encourage teamwork, as analyses and execution proposals are the result of cooperative work.

Cooperative learning, consisting of the elaboration and presentation of a work on one of the topics (techniques / improvement methodologies in TQM, Lean, TPM, etc.) from Thematic Block III, chosen by the team members from a list of proposed options. The results of the works are presented and debated in a seminar.
assessment_rules: The course is passed by obtaining at least 5 out of 10 points in the overall average grade. For the first and second calls, the final grade is calculated as 40% continuous assessment (20% class exercises, 20% lab reports) and 60% final exam. A minimum grade of 4.5 out of 10 is required on the final exam to average with continuous assessment; if not met, the global average cannot exceed 4.5. Class exercises can be recovered in the second call's final exam with additional questions, but lab reports are not recoverable. For the extraordinary finalization of studies call, the final exam accounts for 100% of the grade.
